message.content: {"evidence":"Subtracting the onset offset of P1 (J1→J2) removes the upward jump at J1 in N and E but leaves a sharp downward discontinuity at J2 in all components, indicating the return is not explained by a simple temporary offset; the residual after correction still shows a distinct drop at J2, inconsistent with a clean offset-and-return pattern.","pair_ids":[]}
